changelog: The Config Files page now includes a link to the Owner Support Guide: it explains what each on-screen message means, what you can safely do yourself, and how to use AI -- such as Claude, ChatGPT or DeepSeek -- to do more with your system: set up your own automations, dashboards and phone notifications using the Comfort entities. Nothing about the alarm or your settings changes.
details: v53 is the fleet release of the bench revision 53b (the shipped payload bytes are the bench-verified ones). Owner Support Guide link on the Config Files page. (1) dashboards/system.yaml: the Remote Support Access card gains an 'Owner Support Guide' paragraph -- what each message means, what you can safely do yourself, and 'how to use AI to do more with your system' (automations, your own dashboards, Comfort entities), the AI phrase in bold -- linking to https://github.com/slychiu/ComfortHA-yaml/blob/main/SUPPORT.md. The guide is a public-repo document, not updater-deployed, so only the link ships in this release. The same main-line commit expanded the guide: section 9 'Doing more with your system' teaches the owner to ask an AI assistant (paste-able prompt carrying the alarm entity, arm scripts, zone binary sensors, bypass controls and battery sensors) to build automations and their own dashboards, and restates the safety rules (do not edit the Cytech pages, .storage or the shipped automations; never give an assistant the remote link, login or PIN). (2) packages/cytech.yaml: comment-only bump so cytech_update.sh's auto-restart trigger fires -- without it a dashboards/system.yaml-only payload would not restart Core, and the YAML-mode dashboard would keep rendering the old page. Offline verification: both YAML files parse (pyyaml, UTF-8); the link and the bolded AI wording are present in the card. Bench verification: PASSED on cytech.local 2026-10-17 via the real owner flow -- Check -> Update Now through the Supervisor core-proxy service, from a local mirror built from the tag's blobs: v52 -> 53b, 27/27 files applied, Core auto-restarted each round, pending cleared. Deployed files byte-identical to the committed blobs (dashboards/system.yaml 7ab856be05b2d36d21d9ac908deeb3a2, packages/cytech.yaml eb0ffda0ed017b0f37ceeefe20f6a809); the bolded AI wording is present on the device; the post-restart 4-hourly network check ran normally. The bare-53 payload bytes are identical to the tested bench payload.
